name: How does the design-build process work for constructing an ADU with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How does the design-build process work for constructing an ADU with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for ADUs provides a single point of coordination, beginning with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision and property. We develop CAD-supported layouts and detailed plans that account for structural integration, interior finishes, and exterior tie-in work, ensuring a seamless addition that visually integrates with your original home. Following design approval, we handle all permitting coordination and construction management through to the final walkthrough, delivering a cohesive project with clear communication throughout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process for ADUs manages everything from initial design and permitting to construction and final walkthrough, providing a single point of coordination.
